designObservations: Navigation category tabs change the left panel while dashboard metrics stay visible.
Reservation list uses a narrow single column and tall grouped cards; redesign should preserve date/time grouping while making scanning efficient.
Several dashboard menu labels and inactive indicators are truncated in the current viewport.
Metric scopes need explicit labels; operational totals and full-menu totals are different.
Summary counts changed during observation; stored observations describe capabilities rather than a stable data snapshot.
Cancellation and no-show charging are separate actions and must remain distinguishable.
Menu Blocks Private and Pop-up tab labels are exposed in the accessibility tree but not legible in the captured screenshot.
initialDesignDirection: Dashboard prioritizing upcoming service, reservation workload, capacity, waitlist, and prep access.
Clear menu/date scope for metrics and legible menu names/status labels.
Consistent searchable/filterable lists while preserving date/time grouping where useful.
Keep Prep Sheet as a wide operational table with selectable columns, private notes, and export/print actions.
observationOnly: Only screenshots, accessibility-tree reads, and DOM metadata reads were used during the walkthrough.
All navigation was performed by the user.
No live controls clicked or changed by agent; no forms submitted; no exports/prints/charges/deletions tested.
No customer identities or contact values retained in this inventory.
